question: Find the lateral surface area of a cube with side length 5 cm.
solution:
The correct answer is __100 cm².__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lateral surface area of a cube__ is calculated using the formula:
 
• Lateral surface area = 4 × side².
 
• Given side length = 5 cm.
 
• Lateral surface area = 4 × (5 × 5) = 100 cm².
 
• Hence, the correct answer is 100 cm².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Cube Surface Area:**

 
 
• The total surface area of a cube is calculated as 6 × side².
 
• For a cube with side length 5 cm, total surface area = 150 cm².
 
 
 
• **Volume of a Cube:**
 
 
• Volume is calculated as side³.
 
• For a cube with side length 5 cm, volume = 125 cm³.
